description: Generate a narration script (voiceover + shot list + per-clip visual prompts + music cues) for a personal travel-story video or essay, from a thought-flow master skill and the author's own photos. Use when the user wants "a script", "旁白脚本", a storytelling/故事化 script for a video, or asks to turn a personal travel story (e.g. the death-in-Mexico project) into a narrated video or essay. Output is Simplified Chinese first-person storytelling, engine-agnostic in voiceover and timing, engine-specific in clip prompts. Never runs automatically; acts only when the user asks for a script.
